rationale: The assistant correctly identified the likely cause as insufficient pull-down time after a move, explained the 4-12h standing guidance, and gave the acceptable 'allow 24h' direction without inventing facts or recommending parts. However, once the customer said it was 'maybe on its back', the ground-truth-sensible step would have been to switch it off and let it stand upright before restarting, whereas the assistant said 'leave it plugged in'. It also gave no clear escalation path (engineer / movers' insurance) if it is still warm after 24h and did not address the cool-box food, leaving the plan slightly incomplete.
